title: Speaking — Activities in water
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on activities in water.

questions: When do you normally walk rather than take transport?
Which local route do you enjoy walking along?
Do you usually walk alone or with someone?
What would encourage you to walk more where you live?
Do you spend much time near rivers or the sea?
Did you learn to swim when you were younger?

part2.topic: Describe a memorable activity you did near water.
part2.closing: and explain what made the setting important.

questions: How should communities balance recreation and protection of rivers or coastlines?
What are the benefits of providing low-cost swimming lessons?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to activities in water?
